kids: Sip hot cocoa and eat cookies
Take holiday photos in the lit garden
Join a first come, first served nocturnal garden tour
site: Fruit and Spice Park garden in Homestead
Bring your own blankets and lawn chairs
about: The park calls Fireside Nights a festive fireside evening like no other, with the garden transformed into a holiday wonderland bursting with Christmas cheer.
Guests are asked to bring blankets and lawn chairs, and the park lists steaming hot cocoa, cookies and plenty of sparkling holiday photo spots.
The nocturnal tour of the garden is first come, first served, and the evening is listed in the park's Evening Event genre.
The park's schedule also lists Saturday, January 2, 2027 as a Fireside Nights date, in addition to the five 2026 Saturdays.
Tickets are sold at the door or in advance through the Miami-Dade parks ticket page linked from the park's site.
Fruit and Spice Park is a Miami-Dade County park and lists its phone number as 305.247.5727.
The park's other December programs include a Candle Making Workshop on December 6 and 12 at 11 AM, and a Botanical Jewelry Workshop on December 5 and 13 at 11 AM, both with admission included.
faq: How much is Fireside Nights?
Adults ages 12 and up are $10, kids ages 6 to 11 are $5 and children ages 5 and under are free.
What nights is it open?
Saturdays, November 28, December 5, 12, 19 and 26, 2026, from 6 to 10 PM. The park also lists January 2, 2027.
Can I use a coupon or complimentary pass?
No. The park says no complimentary passes or coupons are accepted for this event.
Are pets allowed?
No. The park says pets are not allowed.
What should we bring?
Blankets and lawn chairs, according to the park.
Is there food?
The park lists hot cocoa and cookies.

kids: Take a family photo with a Florida-style Santa
Pose by the giant Adirondack chair
site: Downtown Boca giant Adirondack chair in Mizner Park
about: Boca Raton's Santa for the evening skips snow boots and arrives in a festive Hawaiian shirt and board shorts, the city says, for a holiday memory that could only happen in Boca Raton.
The meet and greet is staged at the Downtown Boca giant Adirondack chair, a photo landmark in Mizner Park.
The calendar entry runs from 6 to 8 PM and links to the city's Merry in Mizner page, which sits under Recreation Services Community Events.
The city's calendar gives the location as Federal Highway and Mizner Boulevard in Boca Raton, FL 33432, with Google and Bing map links.
A separate Merry in Mizner activity, Stuff-A-Plush, follows a week later on December 15 at the South Gazebo.

The regional family calendar also lists Scroogé, a pop musical take on A Christmas Carol, at The Studio at Mizner Park on December 5 at 11 AM for $32.35, and a Lynn University Gingerbread Holiday Concert on December 13 at 2 PM for $35.
The city website offers a Mizner Park facility page with map links, and an Ask Boca chatbot for general questions.
faq: What time is the Surf's Up Santa meet and greet?
Tuesday, December 8, 2026, from 6 to 8 PM.
Where do I find Santa?
At the Downtown Boca giant Adirondack chair in Mizner Park.
What does Santa wear?
A festive Hawaiian shirt and board shorts, according to the city.
Can we take our own photos?
The city invites families to snap a family photo with Santa.
Who hosts it?
The City of Boca Raton, as part of Merry in Mizner.

kids: Stuff and build a plush winter critter
Finish a plush critter to keep
site: First 200 attendees, first come, first served
about: Stuff-A-Plush invites kids to make their own plush winter critter at the South Gazebo in Mizner Park.
Boca Raton limits the activity to the first 200 attendees and serves them on a first come, first served basis, with no charge.
The calendar entry lists a 6 PM start on Tuesday, December 15, 2026, and a map link to Mizner Park at Federal Highway and Mizner Boulevard.
It belongs to the city's Merry in Mizner holiday series, alongside the Surf's Up Santa meet and greet on December 8.

Other Boca Raton holiday dates on the regional family calendar include a Holiday POPS Concert at the Mizner Park Amphitheater on December 5 from 6 to 8 PM and a Jolly Jamboree at Sugar Sand Park Community Center on December 26 for $10.
The city website lets residents create an account to manage notification subscriptions for calendar events like this one.
On the city site the series page is filed under Government, Departments, Recreation Services, Our Department and Community Events, with the keywords holidays in Boca Raton, things to do and music.
The calendar entry lists a facility page for Mizner Park and Google and Bing map links for Federal Highway and Mizner Boulevard, Boca Raton, FL 33432.
The city lists a 6 PM start time and the first come, first served rule on the same calendar line.
faq: Is Stuff-A-Plush free?
Yes. The city lists it as free.
How many people can take part?
The first 200 attendees, first come, first served.
What do kids make?
A plush winter critter.
When does it start?
6 PM on Tuesday, December 15, 2026.
Where is it?
The South Gazebo at Mizner Park, Boca Raton.
Who hosts it?
The City of Boca Raton, as part of Merry in Mizner.
Is there a limit on how many critters we can make?
The city caps the activity at the first 200 attendees overall.
Which part of Mizner Park is it in?
The South Gazebo.
Is the activity part of a larger series?
Yes. It is one of the city's Merry in Mizner holiday events.
